summary: Lane ora-9 (AH/cardio backfill adjudication, ses_048763c6affeGN4z6NZElhkhTv) returned only a status note ('Adjudication complete') with NO adjudication payload in the task result, violating the Dispatch Persistence Rule (QMS process-mappings.md, CAPA-2026-009): read-only lanes must return the full payload inside the returned task result before lane close.
root_cause: 5-Why: (1) ora-9 completed its analysis but omitted the JSON payload from its final message; (2) the lane focused on closing (MemPalace unavailable, 'trace is the mandatory artifact') instead of the deliverable; (3) dispatch prompt required the payload but enforcement depended on the lane's compliance; (4) orchestrator had no post-close verification step to detect missing payload at close time (relied on re-dispatch after the fact); (5) CAPA-2026-009 corrective action was documentation-only — it did not add a close-time enforcement gate. Root cause: corrective action insufficient; recurrence of the NCR-2026-014 failure mode.
impact: Adjudication had to be re-run via fresh lane ora-10 (~5 min). No data corruption (ora-10 delivered clean payload: 0 changes). Wasted 1 lane. Delay only.
corrective_action: CAPA-2026-009 reopened: add orchestrator close-time enforcement — before declaring any read-only lane complete, verify the required payload keys are present in the returned task result; if absent, re-dispatch immediately without marking the lane reconciled. NCR severity major due to recurrence.
